files.text:
# Registry seed for `scen-check-fix-adds-measurable-criterion`.
#
# One Scenario that names no exact message, count, code or threshold
# anywhere: the greeter "greets" the person, and nothing says with what.
# The fix asks which criterion, then adds it to this entry.

metadata:
  title: "Test Requirements Registry (BDD fixture seed)"
  version: "2.0"
  last_updated: "2026-10-21"
  description: "One scenario with no measurable criterion"

scenarios:
  E2E-001:
    description: The greeter must greet the person whose name it is given
    service: greeter
    path: tests/greeter/greet_test.go
    user_stories: []
    merged_steps:
      given:
        - the greeting is configured
      when:
        - the Operator runs the greeter with a name
      then:
        - stdout matches ^Hello Alice$
